title: Task list remains stuck on the loading spinner after refreshing
body:
## Summary

Refreshing the task list causes the screen to remain stuck on the loading
spinner indefinitely.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Launch the app.
2. Wait for the task list to load.
3. Tap the refresh button.
4. Observe the screen.

## Expected behavior

The list should briefly show a loading indicator and then display the
tasks again.

## Actual behavior

The loading spinner appears and never disappears. No error message is
shown.

## Additional context

- Initial task loading works correctly.
- Deleting tasks works correctly.
- Toggling task completion works correctly.
- Switching filters before refreshing does not change the behavior.
- The issue reproduces consistently.
